szas.sza_tasks:
We are seeking an experienced and motivated individual to support the successful delivery of maintenance contract commitments, ensuring excellence in safety, performance, reliability, and customer satisfaction. Working closely with customers, suppliers and internal teams, the role combines people leadership, project delivery, and operational oversight, with a strong focus on continuous improvement and contractual performance.


The successful candidate will report into the Head of Performance at Newcastle and will demonstrate strong decision making, a proactive approach, and the ability to lead teams effectively while promoting a positive safety culture and delivering against key business objectives and KPI's.


Leadership & Team Development

  • Provide leadership and direction to support the successful delivery of maintenance contract obligations and business objectives.
  • Lead, coach and mentor colleagues, supporting capability development and the onboarding, training, and assessment of new starters.
  • Foster a positive, collaborative, and high-performing culture aligned with company values and KPI's.
  • Act independently and as part of a wider team, making informed decisions and setting priorities effectively.


Fleet Performance & Continuous Improvement

  • Support contractual performance targets relating to safety, availability, reliability, train presentation, and customer satisfaction.
  • Monitor fleet performance, identify recurring defects and lead fault investigation and reliability improvement initiatives.
  • Use performance data and analytics to identify trends, reduce risk, and drive continuous improvement.
  • Develop business cases and recommendations to support investment, performance enhancement, cost reduction, and reliability growth.

Engineering Assurance & Technical Governance

  • Provide engineering assurance through the development, review and approval of technical reports, investigations, engineering changes and supporting documentation.
  • Support engineering systems, processes, and procedures to ensure safe, compliant, and effective fleet operation.
  • Contribute to the management of engineering change, technical file development, and system introductions.
  • Maintain a thorough understanding of engineering principles, systems, and problem-solving methodologies to support complex technical decisions.

Safety, Quality & Compliance

  • Promote and embed a strong safety culture, ensuring compliance with Quality, Health, Safety and Environmental (QHSE) requirements.
  • Support governance and compliance activities, including audits, inspections, risk assessments, and safety investigations.
  • Ensure adherence to industry standards, legislation, railway regulations, and company procedures.
  • Identify, report, and support the resolution of safety, quality, and operational non-conformities.

Stakeholder & Customer Management

  • Develop and maintain effective relationships with customers, suppliers, and internal stakeholders.
  • Represent the business at operational, technical and performance meetings.
  • Support customers with technical issues, in-service faults, and incident response activities, including participation in standby or on-call arrangements where required.

Maintenance Operations & Business Support

  • Maintain accurate maintenance, engineering, defect, and performance records within company systems.
  • Support materials, tooling, calibration, and asset management processes.
  • Ensure trains are delivered safely, reliably and in accordance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
  • Undertake any other reasonable duties commensurate with the role.

szas.sza_tasks:
The Warehouse Material Manager is responsible for independently managing all inventory, purchasing, receiving, storage, material forecasting, and material-control activities for a DMU/ZEMU maintenance facility. This is a hands-on, one-person materials department with no direct reports. The position requires a highly organized, self-motivated individual who can take full ownership of the shop's inventory and ensure materials are available when needed to support maintenance operations.

Key Functions
• Maintain accurate electronic inventory records using the customer-provided Trapeze system.
• Monitor stock levels and promptly order materials that are low, out of stock, or approaching established reorder points.
• Establish and maintain minimum stock levels, reorder quantities, and safety-stock requirements.
• Review maintenance schedules, historical usage, supplier lead times, and planned overhaul activities to forecast future material requirements.
• Maintain a material-planning schedule to ensure required parts are ordered and available before scheduled overhaul work begins.
• Generate purchase orders and track orders through delivery and receipt.
• Coordinate with vendors regarding pricing, availability, lead times, back orders, damaged shipments, and missing materials.
• Prepare monthly inventory reports showing:
• Current and adjusted inventory
• Materials received and used during the month
• Low-stock and out-of-stock items
• Open purchase orders and pending deliveries
• Significant upcoming material requirements
• Perform cycle counts and physical inventory checks to identify and correct discrepancies.
• Receive, inspect, label, and properly store incoming materials.
• Issue materials to maintenance personnel and document usage against the appropriate vehicle, work order, or project.
• Maintain accurate records for serialized, warranty-controlled, repairable, and critical components.
• Create and maintain bin locations, inventory-location sheets, shelving assignments, and clearly labeled storage areas.
• Keep the warehouse and material-storage areas clean, safe, and organized.
• Track Return Material Authorization requests, warranty claims, vendor returns, and materials sent out for repair.
• Follow up on outstanding RMAs and maintain records of item status, location, expected return date, and final disposition.
• Provide management and maintenance personnel with updates regarding shortages, lead times, open orders, delivery concerns, and upcoming material needs.
• Maintain organized electronic and physical records for inventory, purchasing, receiving, shipping, material planning, and RMA activities.

szas.sza_benefits:
In this role, you will carry out defined scopes of work with precision, following Vehicle Maintenance Instructions (VMIs), approved data, and original equipment manufacturer (OEM) manuals. You'll also tackle emergent tasks, performing recovery and corrective actions with efficiency and care. Your ability to maintain and update technical documentation within a computerised maintenance management system will ensure the smooth flow of operations.

You'll operate essential equipment and machinery, including the depot tug, to support train movements and assist with unit positioning for overhaul tasks. Additionally, you'll maintain accurate asset information-documenting serial numbers and usage, along with capturing photographic evidence to support warranty claims and aid future fault rectifications.

Your role includes managing materials and consumables with accuracy, proactively identifying potential shortages and addressing them with the materials team to prevent any disruption to planned work. You'll also contribute to research, preparation, and verification of tasks forecast for our FLIRT units, ensuring excellence and reliability.

Collaboration is key! You'll provide technical assistance and feedback to both local departments and the wider organisation. By liaising with the planning department, you will help ensure scheduled work is completed efficiently and within acceptable tolerances. Maintaining a clean and organised work environment will reflect your high standards of professionalism and care.

Your commitment to health and safety will be paramount as you adhere to company policies, report incidents or near-misses promptly, and escalate risks to your line manager for swift resolution.

szas.sza_requirements:
Key Responsibilities:


The Commissioning Support Technician is responsible for carrying out a wide range of commissioning activities, including functional testing from wiring verification (continuity, insulation, and voltage tests) to the static and dynamic commissioning of complete rail vehicles.


The role involves fault finding using software tools to diagnose and repair issues across electronic, electrical, and electromechanical systems such as doors, HVAC, traction equipment, passenger information systems, train protection systems, and vehicle control technologies.


Accurate logging of all test and measurement results is essential. The technician will prepare and accompany test runs both on-site and on the public rail network to support design validation and vehicle approval.


Operational support includes troubleshooting and warranty implementation at customer sites to ensure high vehicle availability.


The role also supports condition monitoring systems and manual inspections, software uploads and updates across subsystems, and ensures configuration control is maintained. The technician will respond to technical queries from colleagues and clients, provide feedback on incidents, and mentor team members to promote knowledge sharing.


Risk identification and mitigation within the scope of work is expected, alongside producing high-quality reports in maintenance systems and general documentation.


The technician will collaborate with managers and colleagues to improve systems and working practices, maintain health and safety standards, and manage environmental responsibilities. Task prioritisation is done in consultation with the Production Manager, using available equipment and work instructions.


Work is performed in line with safety procedures, with contributions to updating documentation as needed. Monitoring train performance and addressing recurring issues is key, with feedback provided to central teams.


The role also involves fostering effective cross team relationships and supporting any activity within the technician's capabilities.

Are you passionate about the future of rail transport? Do you want to be part of a team that's shaping the next generation of trains using cutting-edge technology? Look no further! Join us as a UK Commissioning Support Technician based at our Newcastle Depot, on a fixed term contract until the 31st December 2027.


Innovative Environment: Working in a fast paced, results orientated environment, you will proactively work alongside your team to ensure services are available.


Growth and Development: You will be part of a dynamic company committed to the development of our people, offering opportunities for learning and career development.


Passionate Team: You will manage a dedicated team working diligently to deliver and provide an essential service successfully collaborating with key stakeholders.


Customer-Centric Approach: You will work effectively to ensure the needs and expectations of our service users are supplied with the highest standards of service.


What We're Looking For: We're seeking proactive individuals who align with our company KPI's and values. If you are looking to make a difference and deliver high quality service then we want to hear from you.


Role Overview

We are looking to recruit a Commissioning Support Technician on a fixed term contract until 31st December 2027. This is key role in supporting the Stadler project team based at Newcastle during the rollout of the new class 555 fleet. This role ensures trains are delivered on time and meet high standards in safety, reliability, environmental compliance, and presentation, both interior and exterior. By applying industry best practices and adhering to engineering and production standards, the technician helps maintain contractual obligations and contributes to Stadler's growth across the UK.

szas.sza_tasks:
As a Commodity Buyer (Indirect Materials), you will manage strategic sourcing and procurement activities for indirect materials, manufacturing consumables, MRO supplies, tooling, safety products, warehouse equipment, and production support materials. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and executing commodity strategies, negotiating with suppliers, and ensuring the timely, cost-effective, and quality compliant supply of operational materials required to support rail vehicle manufacturing, commissioning, and facility operations.

Key Activities

• Develop and execute sourcing strategies for consumables, MRO materials, tooling, safety products, warehouse equipment, production support supplies, and operational services.
• Lead commercial negotiations for pricing, contracts, blanket orders, supplier agreements, and inventory stocking programs.
• Manage procurement activities for categories including:
• Adhesives, sealants, tapes, foams, insulation products, coatings, and chemical consumables.
• Production tooling, tool repair, calibration services, and replacement tooling components.
• Maintenance and repair materials, lubricants, coolants, oils, and shop supplies.
• Safety, fire protection, environmental, and regulatory compliance products.
• Warehouse shelving, storage systems, material handling equipment, and shop organization products.
• Collaborate closely with Production, Manufacturing Engineering, Facilities, Logistics, Warehouse, EHS, Quality, and Project Management teams to align procurement activities with operational requirements and project schedules.
• Manage supplier relationships and performance, driving continuous improvement in cost, quality, delivery, and responsiveness.
• Identify, qualify, and onboard suppliers capable of meeting Stadler's operational, quality, and service requirements.
• Conduct market research, benchmarking, and total cost of ownership (TCO) analyses to support sourcing decisions and cost reduction initiatives.
• Develop sourcing strategies that minimize supply interruption risks while supporting inventory optimization and production continuity.
• Participate in cross-site purchasing initiatives and leverage global purchasing agreements where applicable.
• Support claims management, warranty recovery, supplier corrective actions, and resolution of supplier performance issues.
• Manage supplier implementation of product changes, substitutions, and obsolescence issues while maintaining operational continuity.
• Support Kanban, replenishment, and inventory management programs for frequently consumed production materials.
• Coordinate with stakeholders to ensure availability of critical consumables required to maintain uninterrupted manufacturing operations.

szas.sza_introduction:
Bringen Sie Modernisierungsprojekte von Schienenfahrzeugen sicher auf die Strecke.

Schienenfahrzeuge werden kontinuierlich modernisiert, technisch weiterentwickelt und an neue Anforderungen angepasst. Damit diese Änderungen sicher, normgerecht und wirtschaftlich umgesetzt werden können, braucht es fundierte Zulassungsarbeit. In dieser Rolle gestalten Sie den Zulassungsprozess aktiv mit, verbinden technische Expertise mit Projekterfahrung und sorgen dafür, dass Modernisierungsmaßnahmen erfolgreich und regelkonform umgesetzt werden.

Denn jede:n von uns bei Stadler treibt eines an: Dass Menschen weltweit mobil sein können – in den besten Schienenfahrzeugen der Welt. Um unsere globale Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir nach engagierten Menschen wie Ihnen. Packen Sie mit uns an als
szas.sza_tasks:
In dieser Rolle übernehmen Sie eine zentrale Funktion an der Schnittstelle zwischen Engineering, Projektmanagement, Produktion und Zulassungsbehörden. Sie begleiten Modernisierungsprojekte von Schienenfahrzeugen von der Angebotsphase bis zur erfolgreichen Umsetzung und stellen sicher, dass alle zulassungsrelevanten Anforderungen frühzeitig identifiziert, bewertet und nach-gewiesen werden.

Dabei gehören insbesondere folgende Aufgaben zu Ihrem Verantwortungsbereich:
  • Sie definieren Zulassungsanforderungen und Zulassungsverfahren für Modernisierungs- und Serviceprojekte von Schienenfahrzeugen.
  • Sie erstellen Zulassungskonzepte, Nachweispläne und entsprechende Dokumentationen in enger Abstimmung mit internen und externen Stakeholdern.
  • Sie übernehmen die Rolle der Teilprojektleitung für den Bereich Zulassung innerhalb von Modernisierungsprojekten.
  • Sie bewerten technische Änderungen an Fahrzeugen hinsichtlich ihrer Zulassungs- und Si-cherheitsrelevanz gemeinsam mit dem Safety Management.
  • Sie beraten Engineering und Projektleitung in allen zulassungsrelevanten Fragestellungen während der Angebots- und Projektphase.
  • Sie koordinieren die Zusammenarbeit mit Engineering, Projektmanagement, Produktion und Inbetriebsetzung.
  • Sie erfassen, verfolgen und dokumentieren Anforderungen in den eingesetzten Dokumen-tenmanagement- und Anforderungsmanagementsystemen, beispielsweise DOORS und TeamCenter.

szas.sza_tasks:
As Project and Contract Manager, you will take overall responsibility for the successful delivery of the project and the effective management of the customer contract.

Your responsibilities will include:
  • Taking full accountability for project execution and maintaining a detailed understanding of all contractual obligations
  • Leading and managing contract delivery to ensure agreed scope, quality, schedule, and budget targets are achieved
  • Ensuring that the necessary project resources are planned, secured, and maintained. This includes planning, procurement and RAM
  • Collaborate with the procurement organization and suppliers to secure supply chain reliability
  • Leading the setup and rollout of the operational concept (including service workflows, shift structures, turn-around times, and operational flows) in close collaboration with internal departments and the customer
  • Regularly reviewing and validating the operational concept with the customer to ensure service delivery requirements, fleet availability targets and operational KPIs are consistently achieved
  • Identifying, evaluating, and mitigating project and commercial risks early to prevent operational delays, cost overruns or contract penalties
  • Acting as the primary interface towards the customer's project and commercial teams, ensuring a high level of customer satisfaction and fostering a culture of operational excellence

szas.sza_tasks:
As a Quality Control Inspector, you will be responsible for the inspection of trains to ensure quality and compliance with engineered drawings, specifications, and documentation within the industry's standards. If you want to be part of a team that builds high quality, state of the art passenger trains, this is the career for you!

Key Responsibilities
• Physically inspect components and systems for in-process and/or completed railcars to determine construction complies with approved drawings and Contract specifications
• Improve train inspection and testing criteria or procedures, document inspection results, methods, and criteria and report all non-compliances with the specification or approved drawings
• Perform, and report on, Hold Points and Pre-Shipment inspections
• Monitor performance of quality control systems and identify problems or areas for improvement and recommend solutions
• Maintain and review all quality control inspection documentation
• Investigate and assist in the solution of quality problems
• Identify, report and recommend solutions for any quality control issues

The Production Planner is responsible for developing and maintaining master production schedules and detailed weekly planning to ensure alignment of materials, labor, equipment, and timelines. This role manages work orders, production structures, and ERP/MRP systems while coordinating cross-functional activities to support efficient, on-time manufacturing operations.

Key Activities

• Develop, maintain, and update master production schedules and detailed weekly planning
• Coordinate production sequencing, assembly timelines, and capacity planning
• Create and maintain production structures, Bills of Resources (BORs), and MBGs
• Ensure alignment of materials, labor, and equipment with production requirements
• Release material requirements to Logistics and forecast materialization needs
• Monitor and resolve missing parts to prevent production delays
• Maintain and update ERP/MRP systems (e.g., Infor) to ensure data accuracy and integrity
• Consolidate planning inputs from Production, Project Management, and Commissioning
• Communicate schedule impacts and updates to key stakeholders
• Prepare and distribute production schedules and reports for planning meetings
• Support continuous improvement initiatives to optimize scheduling, throughput, and efficiency
• Manage change processes and update assembly processes accordingly
• Maintain master data, technical structures, and sales order/delivery schedules
• Administer timekeeping systems (Calitime), including clocks and task tracking

• Support the Technical Project Manager to achieve all customer technical requirements
• Own the responsibility to lead assigned sub-project tasks
• Effectively delegate, schedule, and monitor progress of all electrical engineering tasks on a project
• Creation of technical specifications, production documentation and testing protocols
• Coordinating supply chain for project related mock-ups internally as well as externally

szas.sza_tasks:
As a Railcar Maintenance Technician, you will support the maintenance, troubleshooting, inspection, and repair of Stadler GTW DMU passenger rail vehicles operating in Austin, Texas. Working alongside CapMetro maintenance personnel, provide technical expertise, perform corrective and preventive maintenance activities, and support safe and reliable fleet operation.

Key Activities
• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on Stadler GTW DMU passenger rail vehicles.
• Troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, pneumatic, HVAC, propulsion, braking, door and control systems.
• Diagnose equipment failures and support root cause analysis activities.
• Perform inspections, testing, adjustments and repairs according to OEM procedures.
• Utilize diagnostic software, testing equipment, hand tools and power tools.
• Document maintenance activities and corrective actions.
• Assist with training and knowledge transfer to customer personnel.
• Follow FRA regulations, customer safety procedures and company quality requirements.

szas.sza_introduction:
Jeden von uns bei Stadler treibt eines an: Dass Menschen weltweit mobil sein können – in den besten Schienenfahrzeugen der Welt. Unsere Standorte in Velten und Hennigsdorf bilden das Kompetenzzentrum für die Abnahmeprüfung und Inbetriebnahme unserer Schienenfahrzeuge.

Um unsere globale Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir nach engagierten Menschen wie Ihnen. Sie zeigen Leistungsbereitschaft und sind interessiert daran, Ihre Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln? Sie bringen Leidenschaft für Ihre Tätigkeit mit? Klingt das nach Ihnen? Dann packen Sie mit uns an! szas.sza_tasks:

    • Funktionstests: Sie führen eigenständig Funktionstests an elektrischen und elektromechanischen Komponenten durch und sorgen dafür, dass alles reibungslos funktioniert und stellen sicher, dass unsere Fahrzeuge höchsten Qualitätsstandards gerecht werden.
    • Fehlerdiagnose & -behebung: Mit Ihrer analytischen Vorgehensweise diagnostizieren und beheben Sie Störungen und tragen damit maßgeblich zur Betriebsfähigkeit der Fahrzeuge bei.
    • Softwareinstallation: Sie installieren Fahrzeugsoftware und überprüfen deren Funktionalität durch umfassende Tests.
    • Abnahmen begleiten: Sie bereiten Fahrzeugabnahmen vor und unterstützen deren reibungslosen Ablauf in enger Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
  • Teamwork: Sie vernetzen sich mit verschiedenen Teams und Schnittstellen, um die Inbetriebnahmeprozesse optimal zu gestalten.
  • Weiterbildung: Durch regelmäßige Schulungen und Workshops erweitern Sie kontinuierlich Ihr Wissen und Ihre Fähigkeiten.

szas.sza_tasks:
The Order Management Specialist at Stadler US is responsible for ensuring the timely availability of materials and components required for railway vehicle production. Serving as a key liaison between Supply Chain, Production, Procurement, Logistics, and Suppliers, this role drives material readiness to support manufacturing schedules and delivery commitments. The Order Manager proactively addresses material shortages, coordinates supplier deliveries, optimizes inventory levels, and aligns supply with production demand to ensure efficient, cost-effective, and high-quality operations.

Key Activities
• Monitor and analyze the Missing Part List (MPL) to identify material shortages, supply risks, and potential production impacts.
• Lead cross-functional MPL review meetings to drive timely resolution of missing or delayed materials.
• Collaborate with Procurement, Logistics, Production, Engineering, and Suppliers to resolve material shortages and mitigate supply chain risks.
• Ensure all required materials are available to support production orders and prevent assembly delays.
• Drive corrective actions and escalation processes to resolve bottlenecks that could impact manufacturing schedules and customer deliveries.
• Participate in FSK (Production Control/Scheduling) meetings to align material availability with production requirements and final assembly schedules.
• Collaborate closely with Production Planning and Manufacturing teams to support production sequencing and milestone achievement.
• Communicate material risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize disruptions to production schedules.
• Ensure material flow supports production priorities and customer delivery commitments.
• Manage supplier delivery schedules based on changing production demands and operational priorities.
• Execute expedited delivery actions ("push-in") for critical components that may impact production timelines.
• Coordinate delayed delivery actions ("push-out") for non-critical components to optimize inventory levels and warehouse capacity.
• Monitor supplier performance and proactively address delivery issues to ensure schedule adherence.
• Partner with suppliers and logistics team to improve delivery reliability and material availability.
• Lead inventory management initiatives focused on inventory reduction, and warehouse optimization.
• Balance supply and demand to maintain optimal inventory levels while preventing material shortages.
• Identify and reduce excess, obsolete, and slow-moving inventory.
• Build strong partnerships with Engineering, Procurement, Production, Logistics, Warehousing, and Project Management teams.
• Facilitate discussions, communicate priorities, for material-related action items.
• Support process improvement initiatives that enhance material planning, supply chain performance, and production readiness.
• Contribute to operational excellence by identifying opportunities to streamline workflows and improve supply chain responsiveness.

Stadler Converter sp. z o.o. is a Polish company belonging to the Stadler Group, a leading global provider of integrated rail-vehicle solutions tailored to customer needs. At every stage of its operations, the company is committed to ensuring that passengers around the world reach their destinations safely, quickly, and comfortably.

szas.sza_introduction:
Stadler Converter sp. z o.o. to polska spółka należąca do Grupy Stadler, wiodącego dostawcy systemowych rozwiązań w dziedzinie pojazdów szynowych dostosowanych do potrzeb odbiorców. Na każdym kroku firma dokłada wszelkich starań, aby pasażerowie na całym świecie dotarli do celu bezpiecznie, szybko i komfortowo.

W Polsce firma Stadler posiada wiele różnych zakładów, które specjalizują się w produkcji zarówno podzespołów jak i kompletnych pojazdów, a także ich serwisowaniu.

Firma Stadler podjęła decyzję o rozbudowie fabryki konwerterów mocy. Fabryka będzie dostarczać przetwornice do zakładów produkcyjnych Stadlera, a także do innych klientów.

Dołącz do naszego zespołu!

• Collaborate efficiently within a team, ensuring seamless coordination and timely project progress.
• Maintain high-quality standards through inspections and adherence to production guidelines.
• Operate, maintain, and troubleshoot welding equipment to ensure safety and functionality.

szas.sza_requirements:
De belangrijkste werkzaamheden en verantwoordelijkheden zijn:
• Het uitvoeren van functioneel systeem testen volgens protocollen van de omgebouwde systemen. Ook de standaard testen voor gebruik nemen van het voertuig na ombouw;
• Zelfstandig (complexe) storingen lokaliseren, analyseren en opheffen op basis van technische schema's en methodiek van systematisch storing zoeken;
• Het uitvoeren van inspecties op uitgevoerde werkzaamheden van collega's, leveranciers;
• Eén van de aanspreekpunten voor engineering, planning en eventueel leveranciers voor technische en planningszaken;
• Het nemen van de benodigde veiligheidsmaatregelen;
• Uitvoeren van functionele systeemtesten, mechanisch, elektrisch, etc. en bepaalde metingen volgens voorschrift;
• Assisteren bij het assembleren van mechanische en elektrische installaties in de treinen;
• Uitvoeren van werkzaamheden volgens werkopdracht. In voorkomende gevallen, bijvoorbeeld onvoorziene werkzaamheden tijdens onderhoud, maak je zelf een werkopdracht aan in het systeem;
• Het verplaatsen van de trein;
• Het op juiste wijze bijhouden van de te voeren administratie met betrekking tot verbruikte onderdelen, verrichte werkzaamheden en het bijhouden van de gewerkte • Voor aanvang van zijn werkzaamheden controleert hij/zij zijn werkpakket of dit compleet en in juiste staat is;
• Neemt deel aan het werkoverleg, bedenkt creatieve oplossingen en doet verbetervoorstellen die uit de praktijk voortkomen;
• De functie wordt mogelijk ook ingezet voor diensten op buiten-locaties en weekenddiensten;
• De functie kan extra kennis hebben op enkele gebieden zoals ATB of hoogspanning, of betrokken zijn bij projecten en werkgroepen;
• Is verantwoordelijk voor het schoonhouden van de werkplek;
• Houdt zich aan alle regels en voorschriften met betrekking tot veiligheid, gezondheid en milieu, ook bij het afvoeren van milieu-gevoelige stoffen;
•Kan ingezet worden voor het verrichten van werkzaamheden op het spoor als gevolg van calamiteiten en incidenten;

Als Bid Manager verfolgst du das übergeordnete Ziel, Schienenfahrzeuge in die gesamte Welt erfolgreich zu verkaufen. Als verantwortliche Person für deine Projekte bist du massgeblich für den Verkaufserfolg von Stadler verantwortlich. Arbeitest du gerne im Team und treibst Projekte aktiv voran - dann bist du bei uns richtig. Wir suchen eine engagierte Persönlichkeit, welche ihre Angebotsprojekte verantwortungsbewusst und gemeinsam mit allen involvierten Stakeholdern zum Erfolg führen möchte. Die Erarbeitung der Angebote, die Koordination des Teams und die Vorbereitung von Sales-Meetings mit dem Top-Management unterliegt deiner Verantwortung.

szas.sza_introduction: Jeden von uns bei Stadler treibt eines an: Dass Menschen weltweit mobil sein können – in den besten Schienenfahrzeugen der Welt. Dafür sorgen wir mit unserem umfassenden Signaltechnik-Portfolio für einen effizienten, digitalen und nachhaltigen Bahnbetrieb. Unsere Stellwerks-, Signal- und Automatisierungstechnik sorgt für präzise Steuerung und maximale Sicherheit im Bahnverkehr und zeichnet sich durch Zuverlässigkeit, Effizienz und höchste Sicherheitsstandards aus. Um unsere globale Erfolgsgeschichte weiterzuschreiben, suchen wir nach engagierten Menschen wie Ihnen. Sie zeigen Leistungsbereitschaft und sind interessiert daran, Ihre Fähigkeiten weiterzuentwickeln? Sie bringen Leidenschaft für Ihre Tätigkeit mit? Klingt das nach Ihnen? Dann packen Sie mit uns an! We zijn snel, flexibel en onafhankelijk.

Wie kan er nu op een verjaardag zeggen dat hij aan treinen werkt? Nou, misschien jij wel binnenkort! Wat een baan als onderhoudsmonteur bij ons zo gaaf maakt? De treinen zelf, maar ook het kameraadschap dat er onder elkaar is. Wij werken in opdracht van onder andere Arriva en voor ons is het prioriteit dat onze klanten maximale beschikbaarheid over hun materieel hebben. Dat betekent dat je zowel in de werkplaats als op locatie werkt aan voertuigen die minstens 100.000 kilo wegen. Groot materieel en veelzijdig werk; daar word jij gelukkig van.
szas.sza_requirements:
DIT BRENG JE MEE
Als onderhoudsmonteur ben je servicegericht en je vindt het geen probleem om ook door te gaan wanneer het werk nog niet af is.

  • Een technisch mbo 3/4 diploma (mechatronica, autotechniek, landbouwmechanisatie, elektrotechniek, werktuigbouwkunde).
  • Ervaring met het lezen en begrijpen van complexe tekeningen.
  • Je bent zeer geïnteresseerd in alles wat met (elektro)techniek te maken heeft.
  • Je staat open voor ontwikkeling. Wij zorgen wel voor de opleidingen.
  • Geen probleem met werken in twee ploegen (06.45 tot 15.30 uur en 14.15 tot 23.00 uur). Wij werken van maandag tot vrijdag.

Stel je voor: je begint je dienst in de werkplaats en dan komt er een melding binnen van een trein die stilstaat ergens in Nederland. Jij springt in de bus, rijdt er naartoe en lost de storing op. Als er een trein is die het traject niet meer kan vervolgen dan is het streven nog steeds om dit ter plekke op te lossen. Met jouw ruime technische kennis is geen enkele storing te complex. Als storingsmonteur ben je op jezelf aangewezen en wij verwachten dat je hier goed mee omgaat.
szas.sza_requirements:

Als storingsmonteur ontbreekt het je hier aan niets. We hebben een volledig uitgeruste werkplaats met drie werksporen. Wanneer je op pad gaat naar een trein die ergens in het land stilstaat, dan rijd je erheen met een goed uitgeruste bedrijfsbus.

  • Diploma mbo-niveau 3 of 4 richting mechatronica, elektrotechniek, energietechniek of automatisering
  • Ervaring met elektrische schema's en een laptop kent voor jou geen geheimen
  • Geen probleem met werken in twee ploegen (06.45 tot 15.30 uur en 14.15 tot 23.00 uur). Wij werken van maandag tot vrijdag.
  • Doorzettingsvermogen. Sommige storingen zijn niet 1,2,3 opgelost
Eens in de vier tot vijf weken heb je pieperdienst

Het complete team bestaat uit 11 personen, waarvan 7 monteurs. Het is een klein en hecht team en daardoor kunnen we op elkaar bouwen.

DIT BRENG JE MEE
Vanwege de complexiteit van de machines waaraan wij werken, is het erg belangrijk dat je kennis hebt van elektrotechniek. Het komt zelden voor, maar het kan zijn dat je door een grote storing eens langer door moet werken. Dit is voor jou geen probleem.

  • Diploma mbo-niveau 3 of 4 richting mechatronica, elektrotechniek, energietechniek of automatisering
  • Ervaring met elektrische schema's en met het werken met een laptop ben je bekend
  • Eens in de vier weken draai je een hele week consignatiedienst
  • We werken in verschoven diensten van 06.45 uur tot 15.30 uur en 07.45 tot 16.30 uur

De treinen zelf, maar ook het kameraadschap dat er onder elkaar is. Voor ons is het belangrijk dat onze klanten maximale beschikbaarheid over hun materieel (de treinen) hebben. Dat betekent dat je zowel in de werkplaats als op locatie werkt aan voertuigen die minstens 100.000 kilo wegen. Groot materieel en veelzijdig werk; daar word jij gelukkig van.
